attributes.name: Bloody Mandrake
attributes.powers:
On a character at your location's Arcane or Divine check, after that roll, bury or banish this card to allow him to reroll a die and take the new result. After the check, you may succeed at a Craft 10 or Survival 9 check to recharge this card instead. 

While you reset your hand, reveal this card to ignore any cards that have the Plant trait in your hand when determining the number of cards in your hand.

corrections.corrected_text: On the items Blue Star, Cloud Puff, Altitude Fern, Goblinvine, Wintervine, Angelstep, Draughtcap Fungus, Salvation Cactus, Bloody Mandrake, Balmberry Bush, and Witchhunter’s Sword, and the allies Vine Leshy, Leshykineticist, Verdant Rager, and Snapping Flytrap, replace the last power with the following: "While you reset your hand, reveal this card to ignore any cards that have the Plant trait in your hand when determining the number of cards in your hand."
corrections.issue: Does the reset power on plants stack? That is, if I have a bunch of plants, can I reveal them all as many times as I have plants?
